_comment: Cloud Router configuration. Each entry becomes an item in the right-click 'Cloud Router' submenu. On first build this file is copied to destinations.json (which is git-ignored); edit destinations.json and run install.ps1. Paths may use environment variables such as %USERPROFILE% or %OneDrive%. A planned setup GUI will auto-detect these for you.

destinations._comment: Optional 'subfolder' forces everything routed here into that subfolder, no exceptions - handy for a drive root you don't want cluttered.
destinations.name: Backup
